provenance.method: One delegated AI agent reviewed all 72 selected-policy responses and all twelve original documents against the Task 012 rubric. This artifact transcribes its per-case/mode judgment matrix, rationales and audit spans. No human review, blinding or independent semantic validation is claimed; gold labels were not used as verdicts. Exact model identity was not exposed to the recording agent. Source instructions were treated as untrusted data.
